text:
Trevor Connelly, the 19th pick in 2024 and a Californian who came up through Henderson, has seven goals and 12 points in 18 games, and he keeps scoring the ones that matter. His late winner in Detroit on Nov. 5 finished a three-game goal streak, and by our wins-added measure he ranks 19th among 499 skaters.

The process backs him up more than you'd expect from a 20-year-old. Vegas gets 62.7 percent of the expected goals (chance quality) at 5v5 with him on, 11 points better than without him, and NHL EDGE has his top skating speed in the 99th percentile. The finishing is the soft spot: seven goals on 4.5 expected, 21 percent shooting. That cools.

For context, forwards picked in his range since 2005 scored a median 0.36 points a game in their first real season. He's at 0.67. Our range puts him around 24 goals and 51 points; even the low end, 39, is a fine rookie year.
headline: Connelly is the rookie Vegas can't take off the ice
